summary.headline: Addenda and Corrigenda
summary.text: Addenda et corrigenda to the Veneti codex catalogue, correcting folio references, Greek readings, page citations, and typographical details. It cites Nicolaus Rhabdas’s Psephophoria as edited by Tannery, Codex Angelicus 29, Marcianus 334’s cryptographic signs, and R. Duval’s discussion of δημόσιον in Syriac literature.
